title: Training-Free Global Geometric Association for 4D LiDAR Panoptic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2512.18991v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dominant paradigms for 4D LiDAR panoptic segmentation are usually required to train deep neural networks with large superimposed point clouds or design dedicated modules for instance association. However, these approaches perform redundant point processing and consequently become computationally expensive, yet still overlook the rich geometric priors inherently provided by raw point clouds. To this end, we introduce \textsc{Geo-4D}, a simple yet effective training-free framework that unifies spatial and temporal reasoning, enabling holistic LiDAR perception over long time horizons. Specifically, we propose a global geometric association strategy that establishes consistent instance correspondences by estimating an optimal transformation between instance-level point sets. translated_title: 面向4D激光雷达全景分割的免训练全局几何关联方法
translated_abstract: 当前主流的4D激光雷达全景分割范式通常需要在大规模叠加点云上训练深度神经网络，或为实例关联设计专用模块。然而，这些方法执行冗余的点处理，导致计算开销高昂，同时仍忽略了原始点云中固有的丰富几何先验。为此，我们提出了Geo-4D，一个简单而有效的免训练框架，它统一了空间与时间推理，实现了长时间跨度下的整体激光雷达感知。具体而言，我们提出了一种全局几何关联策略，通过估计实例级点集之间的最优变换来建立一致的实例对应关系。为缓解点云观测中结构不一致性所引起的不稳定问题，我们提出了一种全局几何感知的软匹配机制，该机制强制执行……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Geo-4D提出了一种免训练的4D激光雷达全景分割框架，通过估计实例级点集间的最优变换并结合全局几何感知软匹配机制，建立跨时间的稳定实例关联，避免了昂贵的数据训练与冗余点处理。
en_tdlr: Geo-4D is a training-free framework for 4D LiDAR panoptic segmentation that establishes consistent temporal instance association by estimating optimal transformations between instance-level point sets with a global geometry-aware soft matching mechanism, eliminating costly network training and redundant point processing.
